evals.prompt: I'm building a website for an emergency plumbing and HVAC contractor in Dallas. What pages do they need, how should emergency dispatch work, and what features make them productive?
evals.expected_output: The skill must initiate Stage 1 discovery interview, identifying the Local Physical Services & Trade Contractors archetype, asking about dispatch territory and safety triage, and noting atomic crew assignment rather than spitting out a generic template.

assertions.text: Executes Stage 1 interview and halts without dumping full PRD
Correctly classifies business under Local Physical Services & Trade Contractors
Identifies crew labor and territory as the scarce resource
Includes safety triage routing for gas leaks or electrical hazards

evals.prompt: We are a high-end corporate law firm in New York specializing in cross-border M&A and regulatory litigation. Scope our website.
evals.expected_output: The skill must initiate Stage 1 discovery, map the firm to High-Trust Professional Services, mandate automated conflict-of-interest screening, enforce strict privilege safeguards, and explain why consumer-grade chat popups are prohibited.

assertions.text: Enforces conversational discovery gating without generating immediate PRD
Classifies the business model as High-Trust Professional Services

assertions.text: Follows the progressive interview protocol
Classifies business as Industrial, Manufacturing & B2B Supply
Highlights ERP as the single source of truth for contract pricing and stock
Recommends high-density SKU tables and CSV reordering over B2C retail grids
